## Steps

- Negative space gives a small subject room to breathe and can make the photo calmer.
- Back button focus separates focusing from the shutter and helps with moving subjects.
- A polarising filter removes glare from water and deepens a blue sky.
- For the Milky Way use a wide lens, the widest aperture and an exposure under twenty seconds to avoid trails.
